title: Seasonal commitment matrix and sprint-grid for Hosted APIs & model lineup
creator: Asha Patel
description: Purpose: produce a season-aware commitment matrix and sprint-grid that ties Hosted API route priorities to the model catalog lineup and capacity hedges. Scope: map top 12 customer-facing hosted endpoints to candidate model variants, define canary windows, and surface autoscale/burst policies per tranche. Deliverables: (1) commitment matrix CSV for stakeholder signoff; (2) sprint-grid with clear owner assignments and fallthrough policies; (3) console gating checklist and rollout playbook for model swaps. Success metrics: signed stakeholder alignment by launch (PM/Eng/Design), <10% customer-impact incidents during rotation window, and rollout time reduced by 30% vs last quarter. Constraints: limited Dedicated capacity in eu-west region for this tranche, and pending kernel-optim work for quantized variant. Trade-offs considered: pushing a broader model rotation batch vs smaller staggered tranches (we chose staggered to reduce blast radius).
acceptance_criteria: Commitment matrix completed and reviewed by Eng/Design/Support
Sprint-grid with owners and due dates published to Confluence
Canary windows and rollback criteria defined for each endpoint
Console gating checklist added and acknowledged by Console team
Dependencies documented and initial mitigation path validated (ENG capacity, quantization)
